name: vibefoundry
description: Opens the VibeFoundry data-science IDE as a pane, by launching it in a terminal exactly as you would yourself.

interface.shortDescription: Open the VibeFoundry IDE as a pane
interface.longDescription: Opens a terminal running `vibefoundry --no-browser <your folder>` and renders the IDE as a pane. The IDE itself is the `vibefoundry` python package (pip install vibefoundry); this plugin only launches it and relays the pane's requests to it.
